{{Quote|Where were you, uh, picked up?''"<br />"''Excarga. My parents are ore traders. When the Separatists arrived to take control of our ore-processing facilities, they took everyone prisoner, so my parents hid me. Later, when the Republic counterattacked, they picked me up, but I couldn't find my parents.|[[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] and [[Garr]]|<ref name="Crossfire" />}}
Less than a [[Standard month/Legends|month]] after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] '''invaded''' the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Excarga/Legends|Excarga]] after discovering the valuable [[Ore/Legends|ore]]. [[Garr]]'s parents were separated from him in the battle, and the Separatists took control of the planet's ore-processing facilities and took everybody on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]]. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] soon counter-attacked, driving out the Separatist invaders and freeing the majority of the prisoners.<ref name="Crossfire" />
